Extremely Poor Service and Overcharging
Aug 2025 • Family
The service is deplorable. My 10-year-old daughter went to the counter to get some snacks because she was working on building her confidence. The staff serving the food never asked my daughter for her order, and took many orders from others standing around and behind her. I finally had to come to the counter and demand service, and they responded immediately. On another occasion, they attempted to overcharge me. As someone who lived in Vietnam for over 10 years and was fluent in Vietnamese, the staff recognized I was not a tourist and offered me the correct change for the purchase.

Good food , horrible service.
Nov 2018 • Couples
We went there knowing what to expect , but was immensely disappointed by the service . We waited in line for a while only to be met by a lady who couldn’t care less . She threw some things in a roll and we repeatedly pointed and actioned to put specific ingredients in , and even though myself and my partner ordered the same thing and paid the same price we got two completely different rolls. In the midst of this they would just start to serve native speakers - we weren’t going slow or holding the store up nor had the locals had to wait any time. We tried to explain this to the gentleman at the till that our rolls were not what we wanted but they couldn’t seem to care less . And still went ahead . I don’t know if I can just chalk this one up to a language barrier issues or just laziness . The Bahn Mi we ended up with wasn’t half bad. I couldn’t recommend at all - as there are so many alternatives with fantastic food and service within a short walking distance
